key_points: Schwab announced acquisition of Forge Global to open private‑market investments to retail clients, a strategic growth catalyst
Analysts flag the stock as potentially ~20% undervalued as the private‑markets push materialises
Brand strength reinforced by IBD trust surveys placing Schwab among top financial firms
Insider option exercise by director added shares to a trust, indicating no immediate sell pressure
Bond‑volatility commentary noted but not a direct driver for Schwab’s valuation
